messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike in GPU OOMs on decode-streaming pool (us-west-2). 12 nodes reporting consecutive CUDA OOMs, request drops increasing. Pager fired: P1

leo (oncall): I'm seeing the same on the dashboard — loss rate ~2.8% over last 10m. link: https://console.redwood/alerts/1715 (rolling window). Starting triage.

sara.ops: any known deploys?

deploy-bot: Recent deploy: service/decode-runtime v2.14.3 -> v2.14.4 at 1715077400 in us-west-2 (canary -> 20% traffic). No rollback.

leo (oncall): noted. nina, can you check model stats? suspect runaway token growth from streaming clients.

nina.ml: looking — telemetry shows an uptick in avg generated tokens per request for model open-decoder-xl-stream v3. Sequence length pct90 jumped from ~420 to ~6800 in 6m. Many requests with max_tokens unset from SDK variant.

mike.platform: raw logs show repeated allocation failures in decode shader:

```
2026-03-10T14:01:22Z decode-node-62 cuda runtime error: out of memory when allocating 12.0 GiB
stack: init_attention_kernels -> allocate_kv_cache -> decode_step
request_id=qa:7d9c, user_id=acct-xxxx, model=open-decoder-xl-stream-v3
payload.max_tokens=null, stream=true
```

chris-sre: that payload.max_tokens=null stands out — client SDK bug that defaults to unbounded? might be a perf-test client or malformed header.

leo (oncall): status: customer impact yes — dropped responses and 503s for streaming routes. Rebecca, any active customer tickets?

rebecca-csm: two customers reported partial failures, one internal integration test from partner A, and a production customer on us-west-2 saw ~8% of their calls fail in 14:30-14:40 window. They're asking for a timeline.

leo (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) quarantine the offending nodes (remove from LB), 2) apply emergency policy at gateway to enforce request-level max_tokens cap=2048 for streaming endpoints, 3) patch runtime to reject null/unset max_tokens, 4) investigate SDK variant and block misbehaving client. Implementing 1 and 2 now.

sara.ops: on it — running drain + cordon on decode-pool-usw2 nodes with OOM stamp. Command:

```
kubectl label node decode-node-62 quarantine=true --overwrite
kubectl drain decode-node-62 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data
```

mike.platform: applying gateway policy (hot) — json snippet:

```
PATCH /v1/config/rate-limits
{"route":"/v1/stream/*","enforce_max_tokens":2048,"reject_on_violation":true}
```

deploy-bot: gateway config apply succeeded at 1715077896.

leo (oncall): ok once nodes are quarantined we should see OOMs stop. Also start a token-sample capture for failed requests. Nina, can you collect token histograms and sample payloads?

nina.ml: already capturing — saving 500 samples to s3://telemetry/incident-1715077777/samples.json. Preliminary check: ~85% of offending requests have no max_tokens set; many come from a single client-agent string: "acme-loadtool/1.4.0".

chris-sre: rolling restart of decode-runtime on remaining pool to pickup memory fences. Command queued:

```
kubectl rollout restart deployment/decode-runtime -n inference --field-selector=spec.nodeName!=decode-node-62
```

leo (oncall): also increasing autoscale burst for Dedicated pool as temporary capacity bump. Sara please monitor cost delta.

sara.ops: increased max nodes by +4 in usw2. Watchers: cost alarms suppressed for incident window.

rebecca-csm: told customers we have an active mitigation and will follow up with timeline + RCA. they want ETA for full fix.

leo (oncall): ETA: gateway policy is immediate; node quarantines + restarts should reduce request drops within 5-8m. Full fix (SDK patch + runtime validation) targeted today EOD. We'll confirm.

mike.platform: found client IP ranges for acme-loadtool and applied temporary IP throttle at edge to reduce flood.

nina.ml: token histogram: median ~410, p95 2.1k, p99 6.7k for affected requests. Samples show payloads with streaming=true and no max_tokens header.

chris-sre: after quarantining 5 nodes and gateway cap, OOM spikes declined. 14:58 -> 15:05 shows CUDA OOM events down from 12/min to 0-1/min. Request drop rate down to 0.4%.

leo (oncall): good. Next: 1) create temporary server-side validation to reject null max_tokens (hotfix PR), 2) roll back canary deploy if correlated, 3) block offending SDK version in admin console. Who owns PR?

mike.platform: I'll open hotfix PR to runtime rejecting unset max_tokens -> https://github.com/redwood/decode-runtime/pull/3598 (in progress).

deploy-bot: canary rollback queued: rollback service/decode-runtime to v2.14.3 at 1715078002.

leo (oncall): execute rollback if we see any new OOM after restarts. For now keep quarantines. Sara, coordinate with infra to schedule node replacement rather than immediate rejoin.

sara.ops: yes, nodes will be reprovisioned from golden image and rejoin once healthy.

rebecca-csm: customers updated: they acknowledged the mitigation, asked for postmortem and whether this could recur. I've promised a technical write-up + next steps.

nina.ml: note for postmortem: root cause looks like (1) SDK variant that defaulted max_tokens to null/inf, (2) a canary roll that increased throughput to that model variant, (3) lack of runtime validation for unset max_tokens in streaming path.

leo (oncall): assigning owners: SRE (chris) to lead containment and node reprovisioning; Platform (mike) to push runtime hotfix + rollback; ML (nina) to validate sample set and model telemetry; DX/SDK (TBD) to patch client default and publish advisory. I'll add postmortem doc in 24h.

chris-sre: containment complete; reopening monitoring to validate. Setting pager to resolved if no new OOMs for 30m.

leo (oncall): marking incident as "mitigated" for now. Will keep thread open for updates. Follow-ups: postmortem, SDK advisory, gateway permanent guardrails (enforce_max_tokens for streaming default), automated anomaly alert for sudden p99 token jumps.

rebecca-csm: prepping customer notes. If we can share approximate impact numbers: ~3% of total streaming traffic in us-west-2 affected, ~1200 requests dropped in 18m window, two customers reported failures. Confirm before sending.

nina.ml: confirmed numbers from telemetry export: 1,238 dropped responses, 2 nodes with repeated OOMs (reprovisioned), 5 nodes quarantined.

leo (oncall): thanks team. postmortem owners: chris (SRE), nina (ML), mike (Platform), devx (SDK). I'll file the incident ticket and schedule a follow-up in 48h for remediation progress.

deploy-bot: rollback to v2.14.3 completed at 1715078088. No new OOMs logged since 1715078012.

leo (oncall): closing pager escalations. Final action items: 1) hotfix runtime validation merged and staged, 2) SDK advisory + patch, 3) permanent gateway guardrail for streaming routes, 4) retro & postmortem. I'll draft customer-facing timeline. :thumbsup: 

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated, incident_id=INC-1715077777, owner=leo (oncall).
